Truck servicing in Victoria

Keep maintenance planned around the truck and its next run. Discuss routine heavy diesel servicing with Clive Sampson for a single truck or a transport fleet.

Call Clive · 0474 372 852

Make the next service easier to plan

Start with the truck’s make, model, kilometres and engine hours where available. Tell Clive when it was last serviced and whether any work is already due. Manufacturer schedules, operating conditions and service history help frame the conversation.

Share the work you want carried out and the date you need the truck back. Clive can discuss job suitability, where the work can happen and availability before you commit.

What to mention when you call

  • Make, model, registration and engine details if known.
  • Current kilometres or engine hours and the last service record.
  • Warning lights, leaks, unusual noise or changes you have noticed.
  • Your location, truck access and preferred service date.

You do not need to diagnose the fault first. Describe what has changed and when it happens.

One truck or several

An owner operator may need servicing around the next load. A fleet may need to stagger work so trucks are not all unavailable together. Discuss the number of vehicles, their priorities and any downtime limits with Clive.

For ongoing planning, see fleet maintenance. If the issue is happening on the road, start with field service enquiries.

Servicing across Victoria

Sampson Heavy Diesel Services takes enquiries across Melbourne and regional Victoria. Travel and timing depend on your location and the work required. Find your suburb or postcode, then call Clive to discuss availability.
